تزدجري (form VIII)
# تَزْدَجِرِي (tazdajirī) /taz.da.d͡ʒi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# تُزْدَجَرِي (tuzdajarī) /tuz.da.d͡ʒa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
